query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'dev-daio-noteiq'
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30m)
| where Log_s has_any ('/auth/', 'Connect Microsoft 365', 'HTTP handled error', 'Application startup complete', 'Traceback', ' level=ERROR ', ' level=WARNING ')
| project TimeGenerated, Log_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 300
